classification.difficultyReason: Find the radius and centre-to-chord distance before applying Pythagoras and chord bisection.

content.prompt: $AN = 18\text{ cm}$ and $NB = 8\text{ cm}$. Find the length of $PQ$.

spec.description: Horizontal diameter AB and perpendicular vertical chord PQ intersect at N; centre O is marked.
spec.mathematics: AB is a diameter, AN = 18 cm, NB = 8 cm, and AB is perpendicular to PQ.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied answer appears in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord, so $PN = NQ$.
$$\begin{align*}AB &= 18+8=26\text{ cm}\\OP &= 26\div2=13\text{ cm}\\ON &= 18-13=5\text{ cm}\\PN^2 &= 13^2-5^2=144\\PN &= 12\text{ cm}\\PQ &= 2\times12=24\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
